generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The tenderer shall scan original Workdone certificates Turnover Statements and any other documents specified by the employer and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced for physical verification within one week from the date of Technical bid opening
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever
The contractors shall collect necessary samples as required & all relevant requisite tests to be got done by the registered firms with consultants with the Third Party

The contractor has to make his own arrangements for procurement of all materials required for completion of the work in all respects. The contractor shall use relevant ISI mark materials for the work and also obtain necessary quality control certificates from the authorized quality control authority
The Department is not responsible for any delay caused in accessing the https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in portal
The payments for the wok will be made depending upon the availability of funds
The Defect liability Period for the work carried out is 730 days (2 years) from DATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK

itemList.description: Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the at work-In ordinary/soft rock without blasting upto 1.5 m depth (KPWD  2023-24 Page No.08.Vol-1 I.no.1.15.1)

Filling available excavated earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations and other similar orks etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating each deposited layer by ramming and watering, lead up to 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m.(KPWD  2023-24 Page No.34.Vol-1 I.no.1.9)

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite /trap/ basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine  ixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications.Mix 1:3:6 Using 20 mm and down size graded crushed coarse aggregates(KPWD  2023-24 Page No.58,Vol-1 I.no.2.1.3)

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification (KPWD  2023-24 Page No.18,Vol-1 I.no.2.11H)
